description: In crates/core/src/ipfs/mod.rs, block_get maps HTTP 500 responses to IpfsError::NotFound by scanning the body for 'not found' or 'blockstore'. Kubo error messages are not part of the stable API; a Kubo version bump or a legitimate storage failure containing neither substring will cause a real 500 error to be silently swallowed as NotFound, causing callers (e.g. backfill) to treat a missing block as a permanent absence and skip it. Fix: map all non-200 responses to IpfsError::Backend unless the status is 404, and either use the Kubo RPC error code field or accept that some NotFound responses come back as Backend errors (recoverable on retry).
title: ipfs block_get: substring heuristic misclassifies Kubo errors as NotFound
